SourceString: Bzz. Bzz. A surprisingly effective form of governance.
Open the Construction Menu and use the Queen Bee to build a Beehive.
Built to endure even the deadliest strikes.
Light, quiet, and built for those who strike first.
Strong enough to take a hit, light enough to strike back.
Looks harmless enough — until it isn't.
Wood, string, and nerve — simple tools demand steady skill.
Shatters like pottery, except everyone dies.
Power locked and loaded — takes time to ready, but hits hard with a steady hand.
Small enough to go unnoticed, yet sharp enough to end a fight in an instant.
A deafening new invention, feared more for its noise than its aim — and unlike bow or sword, it requires no skill.
A simple vessel, but its contents bring explosive ruin.
A dagger infused with forbidden perfume, leaving enemies to fight shadows. They'll only see you when it's too late.
Once activated, some items provide effects that last for a set number of {C_TRN_C}turns{##}, while {I_TYP_COMEQU_C}combat equipment{##} lasts for a set number of {CO_COMENC_C}combat encounters{##}.
A viscous substance from spirits, feared as much as it is revered.
Pure, potent, and flammable — handle with care.
The difference between a beggar's rag and a duke's robe is just tailoring.
Hinges, brackets, and decorative pieces — used to fasten, support, or add a touch of style in your crafting.
The part you only notice when it breaks.
Nails, rivets, screws — the tiny pieces that hold big things together.
A skin that outlives its owner. Yesterday's beast, tomorrow's fashion statement.
Color in a jar. What else did you expect?
Just paper... nothing to write home about.
A final touch of brilliance for any masterpiece.
A stone honed to a flawless sheen.
Turns rough edges into smooth ones.
They are like nails. But wooden.
A subtle pollen that turns acquaintances into enemies. Plant the seed, watch the hatred bloom.
Carved from the bones of history's most devoted friends, David and Jonathan.
Time and weather ruin most things — except this.
A simple comb can shape more than hair — it shapes perception.
Gaze long enough, and the future will reveal itself — exactly as it was meant to be seen.
The aroma of a legendary swordsman, distilled. Opponents facing you will find their courage — and their aim — suddenly unsteady.
Reminds everyone who they work for.
In an empire where power bows to wealth, a diamond bends the room around it.
You'll reek of booze, mumbling like a drunken wretch. Even vultures will keep their distance.
A strange, bubbling brew that tingles on the tongue, leaving you feeling strangely alert.
What Faust would have killed for: a few precious years beyond his demonic contract. Too late for him, just in time for you.
People trust what doesn't offend their senses.
Not subtle, not meant to be.
A thick, dark grease. Keeps cart wheels moving smoothly while protecting them from wear.
Turn dull edges into deadly weapons, keeping your entire arsenal sharp and ready.
This sacred bible radiates a devotion so pure, even the Pope will be moved by it.
More than paper — this is a key to unlock the loyalty of your workforce, proving you're a true artisan in their eyes.
Ancient wisdom in balm form that heals wounds and restores vigor, turning gray hairs black when no one is watching.
This potent liquor burns going down, yet it banishes even the deadliest illnesses before the empty glass hits the table.
A plank from Noah's Ark, a stone from Golgotha, Lazarus' shroud, or a fragment of Moses' tablets.
Open the Construction menu and use the Holy Relic to build a Shrine.
A sturdy chest that keeps your treasures safe, almost as valuable as the jewels it holds.
Tailored for those who seek style but are wary of the dangers lurking in the city's streets.
Authentic-looking seals and damning accusations turn trusted faithful into heretics in the eyes that matter most.
Rub it once and suddenly regional officials think you're a lot more charming than you actually are.
Slow-cooked tender cuts of meat, their juices mingling with fragrant herbs and velvety sauces.
The oddest things can happen to the wearer of a magic hat...
A simple belt, yet once worn, it fills your mind with the certainty that no one can challenge you.
One dab behind the ears makes you irresistible. Even the most indifferent admirers fall for your “magnetic personality.”
Assault becomes self-defense, theft becomes borrowing, and even if you lose, the executioner will aim for a cleaner cut.
A sealed charter issued by the ruling authority, granting its bearer recognition as a member of the noble estate.
More than mere walking aid, this elegant staff makes those in power see you as their equal.
When shops are closed, a quick swing of this pendulum convinces a merchant to open their store just for you.
Invisible barrier against the invisible enemy — disease stands no chance where this formula was sprayed.
Its music grants great power at a cost. The rats were practice. The children of Hamelin were the prize.
A delicate poem crafted to speak the words your heart longs to say.
A subtle dust that clouds combat instincts, causing blades to waver and strikes to falter.
A divine safeguard against both supernatural threats and mortal gossip.
A masterwork of luxury and protection, the Royal Gambeson weaves power into every golden stitch.
The aura of piety in a bottle — one drop transforms any criminal into a saint in the eyes of judges.
A striking silver chain that draws admiration — and perhaps a hint of envy — for its unmistakable presence.
In city halls, a polished ring says more than a polished speech.
Hidden knowledge revealed. One reading and you'll discover talents you never knew were dormant inside you.
The sequel delves into techniques once deemed “too advanced for beginners.” The author hasn't been seen since the manuscript was delivered.
A candle of eerie flame, burning itself — and half your misdeeds — from official records and witnesses' memory.
Slip a few drops into the drink of someone you hold disdain for, and soon their head will throb with smoldering pain.
For when you want your kids to debate with wit, even if it's in chalk.
One prick puts a rival to sleep at the worst moment, costing them the election. The snoring is a bonus.
A stench so offensive, spies will choose failure over proximity. And so will everyone else.
Feed the soil and watch your workers gather more of everything the land provides.
Your enemy's worst nightmare — evidence. Every spy in the city suddenly remembers seeing your rival at a crime scene they never visited.
Twice the accusations, twice the headache. Your enemy won't just be defending themselves in one court, but two.
A child's toy, a craftsman's first lesson in precision.
Unleashes a stench so foul even rats flee, emptying your rival's shop in seconds. Remember to act surprised when it “accidentally” drops.
Too heavy to steal, but don't forget to lock it.
Offered with a smile to hide its true intent, this potent ale turns a “friend” into a stumbling fool with dulled reflexes.
Sign this distasteful letter with someone else's name, and watch as it sets the stage for mistrust and betrayal among them.
Placed on the doorknob, unnoticed at first, but soon its consequences will stick.
A child's first step toward knighthood.
Worn close to the skin, it absorbs the impact of what's to come.
Made with care, used with caution — this effigy weaves unseen threads between you and those it represents.
Long stretches of road are easier to traverse with a walking stick in hand.
For those who can't afford cold feet — literally or figuratively — these socks are your first step toward winter labor readiness.
A brew so mild, you'll hardly notice... until you're ordering a second round.
Not the tastiest meal, but it's not bad when washed down with beer.
When your workers drag their feet, a willow rod offers a persuasive push to finish the job.
Turns out, wool is cheaper than a funeral.
Tastes worse than the poison, works better than most prayers.
Feels like heaven signed a coupon for your sins.
Poured over weary hands, it turns drudgery into drive and toil into triumph.
The victim sleeps deep, their strength stolen by dreams they cannot escape.
A single breath twists admiration into envy, and envy into ruinous spite.
One sniff, and suddenly “yes” feels like the only word in the language.
A sly aroma that shields from schemes and even turns plots back on their makers.
Breath it in, and reason flees — leaving only the frenzy of broken bodies.
A foul vapor that gnaws through storerooms, leaving rot where wealth once stood.
One whiff and skill itself begins to wither, as if the body forgets what it once knew.
Write it with this, and even nonsense sounds profound.
It creeps through the veins until even lifting a hand feels like moving stone.
Fragrant, intoxicating — hearts warm, reason chills. Few resist, fewer should.
The great transmuter's prize. Its touch wards off sickness, steel, and even time itself.
It crawls under the skin, draining vigor and binding the victim tighter than chains.
The fastest way to miss a meeting. Or a year.
A sip, and even your worst enemy forgets why they hate you.
Because sometimes stabbing once just isn't enough.
A common grain used in both food and brewing.
A dark fluid, rumored to hold unnatural properties.
A craftsman's dream — carves like butter, but don't expect it to outlive you.
Silent remnants of the past, used in rituals and crafts.
Fired clay block, the foundation of almost every city ever built.
Potent botanical that causes hallucinations in small doses, death in larger ones.
Fibrous plant processed into linen for clothing.
A solid bar of pure gold.
Only granite blocks can provide a foundation as strong as stone.
Swift forest creature valued for both meat and fur.
A solid, standardized chunk of iron.
Sweet-scented blossoms that release their strongest aroma at night.
Purple herb known for its calming properties and clean scent.
Human-shaped root believed to possess magical properties.
A substance with an alluring, earthy fragrance, extracted in ways best left unsaid.
Oak doesn't bend — it waits for you to break.
A beginner-friendly wood, easy to shape and tough to ruin.
A variety of precious stones, but not enough to recreate the Imperial Crown.
Its red berries were said to turn aside will-o'-the-wisps.
A sturdy grain, perfect for bread — solid or liquid.
The last outfit you'll ever need.
Precious metal brick, second only to gold in value.
The remaining bone structure that once protected a brain.
Durable and sturdy tile for roofs and floors.
Eight segmented limbs plucked from the stealthiest of hunters.
Bulging orbs harvested from common amphibians.
Natural coloring extracted from plants and roots.
Legends say that wild roses grow where the blood of saints or holy knights was spilled.
Flexible timber harvested from trees that grow near water.
Malleable earth, typically used for making bricks and pottery.
Unprocessed stone with gold waiting to be extracted.
Big, heavy, and stubborn — like your uncle after two ales.
Reddish stone that yields workable iron when properly smelted.
A dull, colorful rock that can be cut and polished to real gems.
Pale-veined stone that catches the light, like a fallen shard of the moon.
Unprocessed rock material, waiting to be transformed into roofing or flooring.
Armor provides protection during all {CO_PHA_C}combat phases{##}.
Equippable items used in {CO_COM_C}combat{##}, including weapons and armors.
Inventory Items are finished products that can be placed in your personal inventory and consumed, providing gameplay effects.
A harmless tonic — or a punishable substance? \nConsult the law on {L_POT_C}Use of Potions{##} before drinking.
Knowledge is rarely dangerous — until it is. \nCheck the law on {L_BOOLAM_C}Books and Lampoons{##} before turning the page.
Fragrance travels farther than gossip.\nEnsure the law on {L_PER_C}Use of Perfume{##} permits its use.
SORCERY!!!\nConsult the {L_WITCRA_C}Witchcraft Law{##} before they bring the torches.
Crafted products used as ingredients for further {A_ACT_CRA_C}crafting{##}.
Intermediate products don't have any effects and can't be placed in your personal inventory.
Raw materials are used in {A_ACT_CRA_C}crafting{##} as ingredients to create {I_TYP_INTPRO_C}intermediate products{##} and {I_TYP_INVITE_C}inventory items{##}.
They can be either {A_ACT_GATING_C}found in nature{##} or created from {I_TYP_RES_C}resources{##} at {B_TYP_EXTFAC_C}Resource Sites{##}.
You cannot place them in your personal inventory, but only manage them through carts and building storages.
Resources are harvested and turned into {I_TYP_RAWMAT_C}raw materials{##} at {B_TYP_EXTFAC_C}Resource Sites{##}.
You cannot place them in your personal inventory, but only manage them through carts and building storages.
Provides comfort and modesty. Neither stop weapons.
Once placed in your Personal Inventory, an item cannot be returned to the Marketplace, Cart, Business Storage, or Storefront.
A few of the Baron's roughest blades. Cheap, loud, and dangerous enough for easy prey.
A seasoned crew from the Baron's ranks. Steady hands, ready for real work.
The Baron's finest. Precise, ruthless, and built for well-guarded targets.
Wounds close. Bones set. The body, reluctant as ever, agrees to continue.
The use of this item is regulated by the law \"{lawname}.\"
A solid iron shot with little regard for walls, windows, or whoever happens to be standing behind them.
Packed with enough combustible material to ensure the impact is only the beginning of the problem.
A cannonball packed with dung and other unspeakable refuse. Damage to masonry is merely a pleasant side effect.
Sweet, sticky, and worth fighting bees for.
Something has gone terribly wrong with this honey. Probably on purpose.
Not the honey. The other reason bees are worth robbing.
Honey stripped of impurities and dressed for a wealthier table.
Fit for a queen — and excellent for a struggling hive.
Proof that even bees can be bribed.
The foundation of a well-organized hive — or at least the human idea of one.
Trained in the ancient art of the One-Point Stinging Heart Technique.
